The Futurist

"In the realm of digital humans and Al, imagination knows no bounds, and the future is ours to craft."

​

David Bennett is a futurist and technologist with over 30 years of experience in visual effects, motion capture, XR, AI, and digital doubles. A pioneer in facial animation, he has worked on films like Avatar, Tintin, and Rise of the Planet of the Apes, and collaborated with artists such as Lady Gaga, Beyoncé, and Kanye West, as well as brands like Warner Brothers, Nike, and Adidas. David has 2 provisional patents one in AI and one in robotics. 

​

Currently, he is focused on developing realtime conversational AI avatars with applications across various industries, including education, training, medical care and well-being. David's notable work and contributions are paving the way for inclusive solutions across new domains, transforming how we interact with and benefit from advanced technologies. 

 

David actively contributes to the global AI dialogue, speaking at events like the AI for Developing Countries Forum at the UN, SXSW, AWE and EU AI policy roundtables.

Shaping the Future of Conversational & Digital Transformation

A leading voice in AI, XR and digital transformation, David Bennett is a globally recognized speaker at industry forums, conferences and policy discussions. With over 30 years of expertise in visual effects, motion capture and AI-driven avatars, he delivers insightful talks on the future of digital humans, immersive technology, and real-time AI interactions.

 

David has spoken at prestigious events such as the United Nations, SXSW, AWE, Siggraph, Siggraph Asia, and Gitex, as well as numerous global conferences, industry summits and EU AI policy roundtables, shaping discussions on AI ethics, innovation, and the transformative impact of emerging technologies across industries.

Meeting with the Pope & United Nations

David had the honor of meeting Pope Francis in 2024 at the Human Economic Forum in Rome, where he engaged in thought-provoking discussions with global policymakers and experts on critical AI dilemmas. David also delivered a UN address, advocating for inclusive and sustainable AI solutions to drive progress in developing countries.

Mimic Productions

Founded by 3D visionary David Bennett, Mimic Productions specializes in digital humans, performance capture, immersive experiences, and XR. With over two decades of expertise in visual effects and 3D technologies, David’s leadership has established Mimic Productions as a global industry leader at the cutting edge of innovation.

 

Based in Berlin, Mimic Productions is a premier 3D animation and motion capture studio, renowned for hyper-realistic digital doubles, virtual characters, and high-quality facial animation. The studio delivers photo-realistic digital humans for a wide range of industries, including film, gaming, entertainment, fashion, healthcare, mobility, and more—pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in virtual storytelling and interactive experiences.

Mimic Minds

Mimic Minds is the conversational AI brand of Mimic Productions, specializing in smart conversational AI avatars. We craft custom AI-driven avatars, seamlessly integrating them with advanced conversational AI solutions to create realistic, expressive, and naturally interactive digital personas as well as characters.

 

Our avatars are designed to engage in real-time, dynamic conversations, bringing a new level of authenticity and intelligence to digital interactions. By combining cutting-edge facial animation, motion capture and AI-powered dialogue systems, we deliver solutions that enhance entertainment, education, training, customer service, healthcare, immersive experiences and more.

Humanoid Robotics and Transhumanism

David Bennett's passion for robotics and photorealistic digital faces has driven him to explore the frontier of synthetic human likeness.

His fascination with robotics began while working on Beowulf, where he oversaw motion capture for Anthony Hopkins' character. A pivotal moment occurred as he studied Hopkins' face—he envisioned recreating it as animatronics. This inspiration led him to file a provisional patent on robotic skin, marking a major step in his research into humanoid robotics.

​

Fueled by this vision, David immersed himself in the intersection of AI, robotics, and human expression. This passion led him to found Mimic Productions, originally envisioned as a robotics company focused on building lifelike humanoid machines. However, as the industry evolved, Mimic Productions quickly became a global leader in digital humans, pioneering photorealistic avatars, performance capture, and AI-driven interactive experiences.
